name: dispatching-parallel-agents
tagline_zh: 同时要写周报、回邮件、改PPT？让多个AI分身各干各的，互不干扰，像开了外挂，省下时间喝咖啡。
tagline_en: Juggling report, emails, slides? Spin up parallel AI agents that work independently—no shared state, no waiting.
desc_en: Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies
why_zh: 同类工具靠对话切换，它靠任务隔离并行，真正零共享状态，速度翻倍且不串味。
why_en: Unlike chat-hopping, it isolates tasks into truly independent agents—zero shared state, double speed, no context bleed.
